title: Scalability assessment of a SaaS platform
summary: A SaaS platform whose performance degrades beyond 500 active customers at the same time.
challengeSummary: A SaaS platform whose performance degrades beyond 500 active customers at the same time.
challengeDetails: The decision to scale was made without data: infrastructure was added without knowing which bottleneck needed it.
approach: A technical health check and an architecture assessment, with technical leadership to prioritize the improvements.

approachSteps.body: Measure what degrades beyond 500 active customers and at which point of the system.
Prioritize the bottlenecks by impact and define migration routes.
Technical leadership that decides the order of the improvements and the criteria to move forward.

solution: A prioritized bottleneck map, defined migration routes and a technical leadership plan to carry it out.
deliverables: Technical health check of the platform

seo.title: Scalability assessment of a SaaS platform | Representative case
seo.description: Representative scenario: how the bottlenecks of a SaaS beyond 500 active customers are measured before adding infrastructure.
